## Problem or need

Describe what you need to do and what difficulty you currently run into.

## Proposal

Explain how the new feature should work and how you would use it.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Describe a behavior that lets someone verify the proposal is implemented.

## Alternatives (optional)

List other solutions you have considered.

## Context (optional)

Add examples, screenshots or links that help explain the proposal.
